example.title: East Mitchell Street historic district storefronts

brief: A row of two- and three-storey brick commercial blocks on a sloping main street: a red-painted brick front with a bracketed cornice beside cream-brick neighbours, shopfronts with awnings, street lamps and planters. One photo (the red building). Older than 1970: Petoskey's Gaslight District (the town's model) is a row of 1880-1910 brick commercial blocks; no newer example of this main-street type exists. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
